fields.statement: At 2ce01c1d: go test -trimpath ./internal/session -run TestResolve -v passes TestResolvePermissionBlockClears' 8 cases: hook blocked/permission at T with Rex idle or working at T+1s resolves from rex; Rex idle at T-1s or at T, a Rex blocked report, or no Rex report keeps the hook's blocked; hook blocked/question and blocked/auth with Rex idle at T+1s stay blocked from the hook. go test -trimpath ./cmd/rhiza -run TestScripts/session-message (GOTMPDIR outside the repo, -count=1, three runs) passes all four session-message scripts, including the new session-message-permission.txtar: a Notification permission_prompt hook, then session run following a fake rex events that reports block:b1 idle a minute later; session show reads idle from rex, and session message logs exactly one `send -b block:b1 <pointer>` and one `send-key -b block:b1 enter` (2 sends total). In a scratch worktree with internal/session/status.go reverted to before dfdc577e, that script fails, so it covers the fix. Diff read: permissionCleared applies only to a hook blocked/permission report overtaken by a strictly newer Rex idle/working report; exit still outranks everything.
